pattern.description: The Gmail reading pane scrolls up through the email thread, moving the earlier messages out of view and revealing the agent's 'Book a meeting with Heather Cartino' time-slot grid while the sidebar and top bar stay fixed.
pattern.why_premium: A long, decelerating scroll lands exactly on the scheduling widget as the voiceover says 'scheduling meetings', so the proof point is framed without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Clip the thread inside the reading pane; gsap.to('.thread', {y: '-=~170px', duration: 1.1, ease: 'power2.out'}) with sidebar/header static; slow tail so the slot grid settles in frame.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 33], [0, -170], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the thread container inside an overflow-hidden pane; or spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 60}).

notes: facts.json camera.move says pull_out (scale 0.956, pan_y -0.237), but the sidebar, Gmail header and toolbar look static in the filmstrip, so this reads as an in-pane scroll rather than a camera move. Worth a human check for a slight zoom-out layered on the scroll.
